retention_decision.flag_disposition: Preserve every case and family flag with its absolute contribution and correctness/resource evidence. Flags do not impose a percentage benefit floor or automatically block a positive complete-cohort decision. Any separately justified diagnosis must preserve the observation.
retention_decision.performance_rule: Ship when candidate complete-cohort engine seconds are strictly less than baseline; drop when equal or greater. No complete-cohort or family percentage minimum.
retention_decision.correctness: Complete values, schemas, callback/error ordering, lazy domains, ownership, resource and cancellation checks must pass. No external execution fallback.

held_out_correctness.scope: Reuse existing independent expression declarations with new seeds and complete independently reopened Parquet inputs; 8 cases x 2 seeds x 2 layouts x 5 interfaces = 160 observations. Native tests cover borrowed dictionary/constant/rich-parent and ownership boundaries. Public join/ordering regressions supplement the fresh expressions. This correctness cohort is not an additional performance denominator.

execution_policy: One isolated sequential execution of each original case in original order with existing storage limits, deadlines, complete validation, concurrency guard and cleanup. Finish other task-owned jobs and agents before queries. Full hashing and recursive inventories remain outside execution. No repeated trials, baseline rerun, cache manipulation or pacing.
performance_clock: sum of engine_execution_seconds for one execution of each of the unchanged 347 cases
